text:
nina (release PM): Heads-up — we need to lock a final 15m slot for the release cut next Wed (Oct 12). Prefer window: 16:00–16:15 PT. Can people confirm availability and owners for canary + smoke?

alex (infra): 16:00 PT works for me. I can own the canary rollout and monitor infra KPIs.

cheng (sre): I'm oncall that day but can be present for the smoke window. Will handoff to ops-oncall for midnight coverage.

jamie (eng): I can join for the cut, but need a quick pre-cut checklist. Can we embed the minimal agenda in the invite?

nina (release PM): Yep — proposed compact agenda below (15m):
```
1) Quick rollcall (30s)
2) Canary kick (2m) — alex
3) Basic smoke tests & logs check (5m) — cheng
4) Metrics sanity & perf check (3m) — release-bot / dashboards
5) Cut confirmation + rollback notes (4m) — nina
```

nina (release PM): Also adding a short checklist to the calendar invite: `pre-cut smoke script`, `canary traffic 5% -> 25% -> 100%`, `alert runbook link`, `rollback tag`.

alex (infra): Added `canary.sh` snippet to the release docs. Quick FYI: if GPU pool spiky, fallback plan is to route to model-quantized-2.9. I'll paste command in thread: `./canary.sh --pct 5 --step 25 --monitor infra`

cheng (sre): ops-oncall — can you confirm you'll be reachable for 1hr post-cut and have access to the escalation channel?

ops-oncall: Confirmed. I'll be in the escalation channel and have runbook pinned. :white_check_mark:

release-bot: Reminder — please add yourself to the calendar RSVP. Auto-reminder will ping 30m before.

jamie (eng): RSVP'd. One ask: can we include one quick A/B prompt regression check in the smoke list? small set of prompts to run.

nina (release PM): Good call — added `prompt-set-v2` to smoke script and flagged it for jamie.

alex (infra): All good from infra side. If anyone is blocked on access to the canary job let me know now.

cheng (sre): No blockers. I'll prepare a short dashboard link and a log grep snippet: `journalctl -u redwood-runtime | tail -n 200` to run during smoke.

nina (release PM): Perfect. Final asks: confirm availability (reply below), and if you want to be a canary owner add "canary-owner" to your RSVP. I'll send invite once we have at least infra + sre + ops-oncall confirmed.

alex (infra): confirming — canary-owner. :thumbsup:

cheng (sre): confirming — smoke-owner.

jamie (eng): confirming — regression-check-owner.

ops-oncall: confirming coverage post-cut.

nina (release PM): Great — locking 16:00–16:15 PT slot and sending calendar invite now. If anything changes, update here. :rocket:
